text:
juli: hey team ":wave:" first day and hitting a weird combo of glitches. Okta SSO flags my device as 'unverified OS' and blocks device trust. I also don't see the 'Eng Starter Pack' in Drive, and 1Password says 'no seats in contractor pool'. who do I ping?

it-support: welcome @juli! which macOS version are you on? we block versions older than the minimum build for device-trust.
juli: macOS 13.0 (went to the office image). the error reads: "Device trust blocked: OS build unsupported (13.0)". is that something i can update or do you need to reissue an image?
it-support: you can upgrade to 13.6 via System Settings -> Software Update. If you're on an image we push, let us know and we can approve a quick maintenance update. try updating and retry SSO after reboot.
juli: updating now.

onboard-bot: Ticket #ONB-8102 opened: device-upgrade-request. ETA 2 hours.
people-ops: looping in People Ops about the 1Password/Drive shares — contractors sometimes land in a separate group which uses a smaller 1Password license pool. @people-ops can you DM me the offer email?
juli: DMed you the offer email. thanks.

(it's been ~15 minutes)

it-support: update: your MacOS updater failed due to a network proxy in the office image. we've pushed a maintenance build and triggered a remote upgrade. try rebooting now.
juli: rebooted, updated to 13.6, retried Okta SSO and now it prompts for passkey migration but fails with 'Credential owned by different identity'.
amy: that usually happens if Chrome/OS has a synced passkey from a personal account. can you open chrome://settings/passwords -> Passkeys and look for any entries tied to your personal email?
juli: found one for juli.personal@, removed it. retrying passkey migration... now it prompted to create a new passkey and accepted. Okta device trust completed!
people-ops: thanks for the patience. your hire record had the contractor tag. i've updated you to full_time and requeued SCIM sync for Drive + 1Password. Expect Drive shortcut under Shared with me and a 1Password invite shortly.
onboard-bot: SCIM sync started.
juli: found the Drive under Shared with me and added shortcut. 1Password invite still pending.
people-ops: provisioning completed on our side; your 1Password invite was queued but the contractor pool had 0 free seats so we allocated a seat from the full-time pool. invite resent to juli@redwood.ai — check spam if you don't see it.
juli: got the 1Password invite and accepted. all green. thanks everyone for the help! :tada:
it-support: welcome aboard @juli! if anyone else hits mixed contractor/fulltime provisioning we recommend contacting People Ops before SCIM runs so we can correct the mapping.
juli: noted, appreciate the quick responses.
